definition_zh: 整洁的；整齐的；有条理的；整理；收拾；可观的（金额）
definition_en: neat and orderly, with everything in its proper place; also to make a place or thing neat
core_image: 把散落的东西一件件收回原位，桌面重新露出空白的表面
scene: 开学前一天，宿舍里堆满了纸箱和旧书。She spent the whole afternoon tidying the shelves so that everything had its place.
sceneCN: 这里 tidy 是动词「整理、收拾」（第 4 个义项：把地方收拾整齐）；句意为她花了一下午整理书架，让每样东西各归其位。画面里有纸箱、旧书、空出来的桌面。

pos.zh: 形容词：整洁的、整齐的、有条理的
动词：整理、收拾
名词（英式）：盛杂物的容器

derivatives.zh: 由形容词加 -ly 构成，义为「整洁地；整齐地」
由形容词加 -ness 构成，义为「整洁；条理」
加否定前缀 un- 构成，义为「不整洁的；凌乱的」

senses.title: Neat and in order
senses.definition: having everything arranged neatly and in its proper place
senses.definitionCN: 所有东西都摆放整齐、各在其位
senses.example: She keeps her desk tidy even during exam week.
senses.exampleCN: 即使在考试周，她也让书桌保持整洁。
senses.why: The word began as timely, meaning in good season, and a well-kept thing is exactly what one expects in the right season.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初表示「合乎时令的」，而收拾得体的东西正是该有时令里应有的样子，于是转为「整齐。」

senses.title: Orderly in habits or mind
senses.definition: careful and organized in the way one works or thinks
senses.definitionCN: 做事或思考时谨慎有条理
senses.example: His tidy mind refused to leave the argument half finished.
senses.exampleCN: 他条理清楚的头脑不允许把这场论证留在一半。
senses.why: If a room can be tidy, the mind that arranges the room can be called tidy too.
senses.whyCN: 房间可以整洁，那么整理房间的那颗心也自然可以称为有条理。

senses.title: A considerable amount
senses.definition: fairly large in amount, especially of money
senses.definitionCN: 数量相当大，尤指钱款
senses.example: The old painting sold for a tidy sum.
senses.exampleCN: 这幅旧画卖了个可观的价钱。
senses.why: A large sum needs counting and arranging, so the neatness image shifts from space to quantity.
senses.whyCN: 大笔钱款需要清点归置，于是「整齐」的意象从空间挪到数量上。

senses.title: To make a place neat
senses.definition: to make a room, container, or surface clean and orderly
senses.definitionCN: 把房间、容器或台面收拾干净整齐
senses.example: He tidied his papers before the guests arrived.
senses.exampleCN: 客人来之前他把文件整理好了。
senses.why: The adjective turns into action: putting things back into their proper place.
senses.whyCN: 形容词变成动作：把东西放回它们该在的位置。

senses.title: To put something away
senses.definition: to put objects away in their proper place, often with away or up
senses.definitionCN: 把物件收回原处，常与 away 或 up 连用
senses.example: Please tidy away the tools before you leave.
senses.exampleCN: 离开前请把工具收拾好。
senses.why: Here the focus is on the objects leaving the open surface, one movement of order at a time.
senses.whyCN: 这里着眼的是物件离开台面，每一次动作都是一点秩序的恢复。

senses.title: A container for odds and ends
senses.definition: a small container, usually open and decorative, for small objects
senses.definitionCN: 通常无盖、有装饰性的小容器，用来装零碎物件
senses.example: She dropped the keys into the china tidy by the door.
senses.exampleCN: 她把钥匙丢进门边的瓷制收纳盒。
senses.why: The container is the idea of neatness made into an object: a place that exists just for stray things.
senses.whyCN: 这个容器是「整洁」实体化的产物：一个专为散乱小物而存在的地方。

senses.title: Tidy as opposed to untidy
senses.definition: used to contrast an arranged state with a disordered one
senses.definitionCN: 用来对比整齐状态与凌乱状态
senses.example: A tidy shelf hides the same books that an untidy heap buries.
senses.exampleCN: 整洁的书架与凌乱的书堆里放的是同样的书。
senses.why: The word draws its force from contrast: order is only visible when disorder is possible.
senses.whyCN: 这个词的力量来自对比：只有凌乱可能出现时，整齐才被看见。

senses.title: Looking well cared for
senses.definition: appearing neat, clean, and well maintained
senses.definitionCN: 显得干净、整洁、保养得当
senses.example: The little garden looked tidy after the spring rain.
senses.exampleCN: 春雨过后，小花园显得干干净净。
senses.why: From rooms and objects the sense extends to any appearance of care, including a garden or a uniform.
senses.whyCN: 从房间物件延伸出去，这份「照料得当」的样子也适用于花园或制服。

intro.en: The adjective is recorded from the thirteenth century as meaning timely or seasonable, and it is usually explained as a derivative of tide in its old sense of time or season.
intro.cn: 这个形容词在十三世纪出现，意为「合时令的」，一般解释为由 tide 的古义「时间、时令」派生而来。

items.en: The noun tid meant time, hour, or season, a sense still visible in the fixed phrases of the calendar.
items.cn: 古英语名词 tid 意为「时间、时辰、季节」，这个意思在历法用语里还留得下来。

items.en: Tidi appears in the sense of seasonable or occurring at the right time.
items.cn: 中古英语中 tidi 出现，表示「合时令的、时机恰当的」。

items.en: From timely the sense slides to decent and respectable, then to well kept and neat in appearance.
items.cn: 由「合时令」滑向「得体、像样」，再滑向「收拾得好、外观整齐」。

items.en: The adjective becomes the everyday word for a room or person that is orderly.
items.cn: 这个形容词成为日常用语，指房间或人有条理。

items.en: The verb to tidy, meaning to put in order, develops from the adjective and is standard by the eighteenth century.
items.cn: 表示「整理」的动词 tidy 由形容词发展而来，到十八世纪已属标准用法。

items.en: A tidy in British English also names a small decorative container for small objects.
items.cn: 英式英语里 a tidy 还指装小物件的装饰性小容器。

note.en: The look-alikes below share the tidy stem or its negated form, while the near-meaning group gathers words for order and cleaning.
note.cn: 下面形近组与本词同词干或为其否定形式，近义组则收集表示秩序与清洁的词。

entries.definition: in a neat and orderly way
the quality of being neat and orderly
not neat, with things out of place
the alternate rise and fall of the sea, from an older word for time
entries.definitionCN: 潮汐；由古义「时间」而来，只是拼写相近的同一词根

entries.definition: clean, orderly, and pleasingly simple
arranged in a regular and controlled way
perfectly clean, without any marks
dirty and disordered

normalIntro.en: The memories below work from the old sense of time behind the word, from its common collocations, and from its family of forms.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从词中「时间」的古义、常用搭配以及同族形式入手。

normal.en: Tide used to mean time, so a tidy room is one that is right for its hour.
normal.cn: tide 古义为「时间」，所以整洁的房间就是与此刻相称的房间。

normal.en: Tidy up is the phrase to keep: up closes the container, and closing ends the mess.
normal.cn: 记住 tidy up 这个搭配：up 意味合上，合上就结束了凌乱。

normal.en: The -y ending makes the adjective, the -ily and -ness endings build its adverb and noun.
normal.cn: -y 结尾构成形容词，-ily 与 -ness 分别造出副词和名词。

normal.en: Untidy is tidy plus un-, and the prefix simply flips the order back into a heap.
normal.cn: untidy 是 tidy 加 un-，这个前缀把秩序重新翻成一堆乱。

normal.en: A tidy sum pairs the word with money, so neatness can be counted as well as seen.
normal.cn: tidy sum 把本词与钱搭配，可见整洁也能被数出来。

abstract.en: Picture a desk at dusk: folders fanned out, then closing one by one until a pale rectangle of wood appears.
abstract.cn: 想象傍晚的书桌：文件夹摊开，随后一份份合上，直到露出淡色的木面。

abstract.en: Think of a drawer that clicks shut, and the click is the sound of order returning.
abstract.cn: 想一只咔哒合上的抽屉，那一声就是秩序回来。

abstract.en: Neatness is a kind of courtesy: the next person to sit down finds the chair empty.
abstract.cn: 整洁是一种体贴：下一位坐下的人看见的是一把空椅子。

examples.en: She tidied the kitchen before the guests arrived.
examples.cn: 客人来之前她把厨房收拾干净了。

examples.en: Keep your notes tidy and you will find them faster.
examples.cn: 笔记保持整齐，找起来就会快。

examples.en: The old coins brought a tidy sum at auction.
examples.cn: 那些旧硬币在拍卖会上卖了个好价钱。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「太一丁」——桌子收拾得一点都不剩，干干净净。

root: 一般认为来自古英语名词 tid（时间、时令），加形容词后缀 -ig 构成 tidi，原义「合时令的」，后转指「得体、整齐」。与 tide（潮汐）同源，tide 的古义也是「时间」。

sensesIntro.en: From the core idea of things being right for their place and time, the entry spreads into neat appearance, orderly habits, large amounts, the act of putting things away, and even the container that holds loose objects.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「各就其位、合乎其时」这一核心出发，本词展开到外观整洁、习性有条理、可观的数目、收拾的动作，乃至盛放零碎物件的容器。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: scattered things returning to their proper places until the surface is clear.
core.cn: 核心意象：散落之物纷纷回到原位，台面重新空出来。

branches.en: The physical order of objects in a space.
branches.cn: 物件在空间中的物理秩序。

branches.en: Order carried inside a person's habits and thinking.
branches.cn: 秩序进入人的习性与思维。

branches.en: Neatness applied to quantity and money.
branches.cn: 整洁挪用到数量与钱款上。

branches.en: The action of restoring order.
The container of order and the contrast that makes it visible.
branches.cn: 承载秩序的容器，以及让秩序可见的对比。

intro.en: The word is a native English formation from a noun stem plus a Germanic adjective ending, with a negative prefix available for the opposite.
intro.cn: 本词是英语本土构词：名词词干加日耳曼语形容词后缀，另可用否定前缀构成反义。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source here, so the Latin list is left empty; the Latin-looking pieces below belong to the borrowed Latin words listed as affixes for comparison.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁语来源，故拉丁同源词留空；下面列出的拉丁词形仅作对照。

items.example: The old sense survives in calendar phrases.
items.exampleCN: 这个古义仍保存在历法用语里。

items.meaning: forming an adjective from a noun
items.meaningCN: 构成形容词的日耳曼语后缀
items.example: It turned the noun for time into an adjective meaning seasonable.
items.exampleCN: 它把「时间」名词变成表示「合时令」的形容词。

items.example: The final -y of tidy comes from this same ending in its modern shape.
items.exampleCN: tidy 末尾的 -y 就是这一后缀的现代形态。

items.example: Tidily adds -ly to the adjective.
Tidiness names the quality.
Untidy is simply un- plus tidy.
items.exampleCN: untidy 就是 un- 加 tidy。

items.example: The borrowed pattern gives words such as manageable.
items.exampleCN: 这一借入后缀造出 manageable 一类的词。

items.meaning: result or means of an action
items.example: The same suffix appears in arrangement.
items.exampleCN: 同一后缀也出现在 arrangement 中。

items.example: Organization uses this ending for the act of putting in order.
items.exampleCN: organization 用这个结尾表示整理的动作。

definition_zh: 领带；绳子；联系；平局；系；绑；打结；打平
definition_en: to fasten something with string or rope, or a strip of cloth worn round the neck; also a bond between people or a level score
core_image: 两根绳头被拉紧打成一个结，两样东西从此连在一起
scene: 比赛进入最后一分钟，两队分数还完全相同。The two teams were still tied at two goals each when the whistle blew.
sceneCN: 这里 tie 是「打成平局」（第 7 个义项：比分相同）；句意为哨响时两队仍是二比二平。画面里有记分牌、哨子与球员。

pos.zh: 动词：系、绑、打结；打平；相配
名词：领带；绳子；联系；平局
名词：铁轨枕木（美式）

derivatives.zh: 加否定前缀 un- 构成，义为「解开；松开」
由过去分词形容词化，义为「被系住的；捆绑的」
复合词，义为「决胜局；平局决胜」
由现在分词名词化，义为「打结；系缚的动作」

senses.title: To fasten with string or rope
senses.definition: to fasten something or someone with string, rope, or a similar material
senses.definitionCN: 用绳子或类似材料把某物或某人固定住
senses.example: He tied the boat to the post before the storm came.
senses.exampleCN: 暴风雨来临前，他把小船拴在柱子上。
senses.why: The Old English verb meant to bind, and every later sense grows out of that single act of pulling two things together.
senses.whyCN: 古英语动词意为「捆绑」，此后所有义项都从这一个把两样东西拉在一起的动作长出。

senses.title: To make a knot
senses.definition: to form a knot by crossing and pulling the ends of a string
senses.definitionCN: 把绳子的两端交叉拉紧做成结
senses.example: She tied her shoelaces twice to be safe.
senses.exampleCN: 为了保险，她把鞋带系了两道。
senses.why: A knot is what a bind leaves behind: a small permanent object made of the act of binding.
senses.whyCN: 结是捆绑留下的东西：一个由捆绑动作做成的小小固定物。

senses.title: A necktie
senses.definition: a narrow strip of cloth worn around the neck and tied at the front
senses.definitionCN: 系在颈前打结的窄条布料
senses.example: He chose a dark tie for the interview.
senses.exampleCN: 他挑了一条深色领带参加面试。
senses.why: The tie is literally a binding round the neck, wearing the original act on the body.
senses.whyCN: 领带就是颈上的一圈系缚，把原始动作穿在了身上。

senses.title: A bond between people
senses.definition: a connection of affection, duty, or shared experience between people
senses.definitionCN: 人与人之间由感情、责任或共同经历形成的连结
senses.example: The two sisters kept a close tie after moving to different cities.
senses.exampleCN: 搬去不同城市后，两姐妹仍保持紧密的联系。
senses.why: Two separate lives are bound together just as two ends are bound in a knot.
senses.whyCN: 两条独立的生活被绑在一起，正如两个绳头在结中相绑。

senses.title: A draw in a game
senses.definition: a result in which two sides have the same score
senses.definitionCN: 双方得分相同的结果
senses.example: The final ended in a tie.
senses.exampleCN: 决赛以平局收场。
senses.why: No side is pulled tighter than the other, so the two remain bound level on the scoreboard.
senses.whyCN: 两边谁都没被拉得更紧，于是在记分牌上停在同一水平。

senses.title: To score level
senses.definition: to make the score equal in a game or contest
senses.definitionCN: 在比赛或竞赛中把比分拉成相同
senses.example: A late goal tied the game at one each.
senses.exampleCN: 临近终场的一个进球把比分扳成一比一。
senses.why: The verb repeats the noun: the sides become bound level by a single action.
senses.whyCN: 动词复现了名词：一次动作让双方落到同一水平。

senses.title: To be tied at a score
senses.definition: to be in a position where both sides have the same score in a match
senses.definitionCN: 比赛中双方得分相同的状态
senses.example: The teams were tied at two goals each when the whistle blew.
senses.exampleCN: 哨响时两队仍是二比二平。
senses.why: A level score holds the two sides together, unable to break away.
senses.whyCN: 平分把双方拴在一起，谁也无法拉开。

senses.title: To be connected with
senses.definition: to be closely connected with or to match another thing
senses.definitionCN: 与另一事物密切相关或相互配合
senses.example: The new album ties in with the film of the same name.
senses.exampleCN: 这张新专辑与同名电影相互配合。
senses.why: What is joined by a string moves together, so things that must be understood together are said to tie in.
senses.whyCN: 用绳连着的东西会一起移动，因此须一同理解的事物也说成 tie in。

senses.title: A railway sleeper
senses.definition: a heavy wooden or concrete support laid across a railway track
senses.definitionCN: 横铺在铁轨下的粗木或混凝土支撑物
senses.example: The workers replaced every tie along the old line.
senses.exampleCN: 工人们更换了旧线路上的每一根枕木。
senses.why: The sleeper is a tie because it ties the two steel rails to a fixed distance.
senses.whyCN: 枕木之所以叫 tie，是因为它把两条钢轨拴在固定间距上。

senses.title: To restrict by duty
senses.definition: to limit someone's freedom of action by duty, rules, or promises
senses.definitionCN: 通过责任、规则或承诺限制某人的行动自由
senses.example: The contract ties him to the company for three years.
senses.exampleCN: 合同把他约束在公司三年。
senses.why: A bound person cannot move away, so obligation is described with the rope word.
senses.whyCN: 被绑住的人走不开，于是义务也用这条绳子的词来表达。

intro.en: The noun and verb both go back to Old English, where the sense of a cord or bond already covered fastening, and the sport sense of an equal score is much later.
intro.cn: 名词与动词都可追溯到古英语，当时「绳、束缚」的意思已包含捆绑之意，「比分相同」的体育义项出现很晚。

items.en: The noun teag and the verb tiegan meant a cord and to bind.
items.cn: 名词 teag 与动词 tiegan 意为「绳」和「捆绑」。

items.en: The verb covered not only ropes but any obligation that holds a person.
items.cn: 这个动词不仅指绳子，也指任何把人拴住的义务。

items.en: The word settles into the modern spelling tie and keeps both cord and bond.
items.cn: 这个词定型为现代拼写 tie，同时保留「绳索」与「纽带」两层。

items.en: The necktie sense becomes common in the nineteenth century with formal dress.
items.cn: 领带义项在十九世纪随正式着装普及。

items.en: Sports writing extends the word to an equal score and to scoring level.
items.cn: 体育报道把本词扩展到平分与追平比分。

items.en: Railway use names the sleeper that ties the rails to gauge.
items.cn: 铁路用语用本词命名把钢轨固定在轨距上的枕木。

note.en: The look-alikes share the spelling pattern of the short stem, while the near-meaning group gathers other words for binding and for drawn results.
note.cn: 形近组围绕这个短词干的拼写，近义组则收集其它表示捆绑与平局结果的词。

entries.definition: to undo a knot or a fastening
fastened with rope, or level in score
the act of fastening with string
one of several rows or levels, a different word in origin
entries.definitionCN: 一层；一排，只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: to tie something tightly together
to attach or close something firmly
a result with equal scores
a join made by tying thread or rope

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the original meaning of binding, from common phrases, and from the word family.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从「捆绑」的本义、常用短语与词族出发。

normal.en: Tie means to bind, so a business tie binds people just as a rope binds a boat.
normal.cn: tie 意为捆绑，所以生意上的 tie 像绳子系船一样把人绑在一起。

normal.en: Untie is un- plus tie, the prefix doing the work of loosening.
normal.cn: untie 是 un- 加 tie，前缀做的就是松开的活。

normal.en: Tie up means both to fasten and to occupy, because a tied thing cannot be used freely.
normal.cn: tie up 既指系紧也指占用，因为被绑住的东西不能自由使用。

normal.en: A tie in football ties the two scores to the same number.
normal.cn: 足球里的 tie 把两边的比分拴在同一个数上。

normal.en: The spelling change to tying keeps the y after a vowel, as in dying.
normal.cn: 变成 tying 时 y 保留在元音后，和 dying 一样。

abstract.en: Picture two loose ends pulled in opposite directions until the knot snaps tight.
abstract.cn: 想象两个松散的绳头被向反方向拉，直到结猛然收紧。

abstract.en: Think of a necktie as a rope that fashion has made polite.
abstract.cn: 把领带想成一条被时尚变得得体的绳子。

abstract.en: A draw on the scoreboard is a rope holding both teams at the same height.
abstract.cn: 记分牌上的平局就是一根把两队拉在同一高度的绳。

examples.en: He tied the parcel with brown string.
examples.cn: 他用棕色细绳把包裹捆好。

examples.en: The game ended in a tie, so both teams stayed on the field.
examples.cn: 比赛以平局结束，两队都留在了场上。

examples.en: Strong family ties helped her through the difficult year.
examples.cn: 牢固的家庭纽带帮她度过了艰难的一年。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「太」——绳子拉得太紧，一下就系上了。

sensesIntro.en: From the single act of binding grow the cord, the necktie, the bond between people, the level score, and the duty that limits freedom, while the railway sleeper keeps the most literal sense.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「捆绑」这一个动作长出绳索、领带、人际纽带、平分比分与限制自由的责任，而铁路枕木保留了最字面的意思。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two ends pulled together and held by a knot.
core.cn: 核心意象：两个绳头被拉到一起，被一个结固定住。

branches.en: The physical act and its result.
Objects made of a binding.
Binding carried into human relationships.
Binding two scores level.
branches.cn: 把两个比分拴成同一水平。

branches.en: Things joined in meaning or held by duty.
branches.cn: 意义上相连或由义务拴住的事物。

latinIntro.en: No Latin original lies behind tie; the Latin items are listed only for comparison with borrowed words of similar meaning.

Tying keeps a y before the ending.

items.example: Ties serves as plural and third person.

items.meaning: used at the start of compounds

items.example: A tie-clip holds a tie to a shirt.
items.exampleCN: tie-clip 把领带夹在衬衫上。

items.example: A tie-less shirt needs no necktie.

definition_zh: 紧的；绷紧的；严密的；紧身的小；紧凑的；吝啬的；紧箝的（比赛）
definition_en: firmly fixed or stretched so that there is no slack; also closely controlled, hard to get, or nearly equal
core_image: 一根绷到极限的绳子，中间没有一点松弛的余量
scene: 箱子早已塞满，拉链还差最后一截合不上。He shut the lid with a tight press of both hands.
sceneCN: 这里 tight 是「紧的、绷紧的」（第 1 个义项：固定得很牢、没有余量）；句意是他双手使劲一压才把盖子合上。画面里有满溢的箱子与紧绷的拉链。

pos.zh: 形容词：紧的、绷紧的；严密的；紧身的；紧张的
副词：紧紧地、牢牢地

derivatives.zh: 加 -ly 构成，义为「紧紧地；严密地」
加 -en 构成，义为「使变紧；收紧」
加 -ness 构成，义为「紧；紧密程度」
复合词，义为「吝啬的；手紧的」

senses.title: Firmly stretched, without slack
senses.definition: fixed or stretched firmly so that there is no loose part
senses.definitionCN: 固定或拉伸得很牢，没有松弛的部分
senses.example: Make sure the lid is tight before you shake the bottle.
senses.exampleCN: 摇瓶子前先确保盖子盖紧。
senses.why: Old English thight meant dense or close-packed, and density is exactly what stops things from moving.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 thight 意为「密集、挤紧」，而密集正是让东西动不了的原因。

senses.title: Fitting closely to the body
senses.definition: fitting the body very closely, leaving little room
senses.definitionCN: 紧贴身体、几乎不留空隙
senses.example: These shoes are too tight for walking all day.
senses.exampleCN: 这双鞋太紧了，不能走一整天。
senses.why: Cloth stretched over the body shows no slack, the same picture as the taut rope.
senses.whyCN: 裹在身上的布没有余量，与绷紧的绳子是同一幅图。

senses.title: Strictly controlled
senses.definition: strictly controlled or guarded, with little freedom or movement
senses.definitionCN: 受到严格控制或看管，几乎没有自由或松动
senses.example: Security was tight at the airport that morning.
senses.exampleCN: 那天早上机场安检很严密。
senses.why: A tight arrangement leaves no gap, so rules that leave no gap are called tight.
senses.whyCN: 紧凑的安排不留缝隙，所以不留缝隙的规矩也叫紧。

senses.title: Closely packed in time
senses.definition: having very little spare time, or happening in quick succession
senses.definitionCN: 几乎没有空闲时间，或接连快速发生
senses.example: We finished the report on a tight schedule.
senses.exampleCN: 我们在紧凑的日程中完成了报告。
senses.why: Hours pressed together like goods packed tight leave no slack in the day.
senses.whyCN: 小时像货物一样挤紧，一天里就没有松动的余地。

senses.title: Hard to obtain
senses.definition: difficult to get because there is very little of it
senses.definitionCN: 因数量极少而难以获得
senses.example: Money was tight in the months after the factory closed.
senses.exampleCN: 工厂关门后的几个月里，手头很紧。
senses.why: When supply is packed thin, everything pulled from it comes away tight.
senses.whyCN: 供应被挤得很薄时，能从中取出的东西自然紧俏。

senses.title: Nearly equal in a contest
senses.definition: with very little difference between the sides in a game or vote
senses.definitionCN: 比赛或投票中双方差距极小
senses.example: It was a tight match that could have gone either way.
senses.exampleCN: 这是一场势均力敌的比赛，谁赢都说得过去。
senses.why: Two sides held close together have no room to separate, so the contest feels tight.
senses.whyCN: 双方被紧紧贴住、无法分开，于是比赛显得「紧」。

senses.title: Firmly and closely
senses.definition: in a firm, close, or secure way
senses.definitionCN: 以牢固、贴近或安全的方式
senses.example: Hold tight to the rail while the ferry turns.
senses.exampleCN: 渡轮转弯时紧紧抓住栏杆。
senses.why: This adverb simply applies the adjective's closeness to the manner of an action.
senses.whyCN: 这个副词只是把形容词的「贴紧」用到动作方式上。

senses.title: Drunk (informal)
senses.definition: in a state of being drunk, used informally
senses.definitionCN: 口语中表示喝醉了
senses.example: He got a little tight at the wedding.
senses.exampleCN: 他在婚礼上喝得有点醉。
senses.why: One informal theory links this slang to a body packed and unable to move; the origin is not certain.
senses.whyCN: 一种口语化的说法把这个俚语义与「身体被塞满、动不了」联系起来，来源不确定。

intro.en: The adjective is native and is recorded from Old English with the sense of dense or close-packed, from which all the modern senses of closeness descend.
intro.cn: 这个形容词是本土词，古英语已出现，意为「密集、挤紧」，现代所有「紧、贴近」的意思都由它延伸。

items.en: The word thight described something dense, solid, or closely packed.
items.cn: 古英语 thight 形容密集、坚实或挤得很紧的东西。

items.en: The sense widens from packed material to anything firmly fixed, including clothing and knots.
items.cn: 词义从密实的材料扩展到任何固定得很牢的东西，包括衣服与绳结。

items.en: The word takes on the abstract sense of strict control and of scarcity.
items.cn: 本词取得「严格控制」与「稀缺」的抽象义。

items.en: Sporting and business writing uses tight for a narrow margin or a crowded schedule.
items.cn: 体育与商业写作把 tight 用于微弱差距或紧凑日程。

items.en: The verb tighten and the adverb tightly are formed from the adjective.
items.cn: 动词 tighten 与副词 tightly 由这个形容词构成。

items.en: The informal sense of being drunk has no firmly established origin.
items.cn: 「喝醉」这一口语义项没有确定来源。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers forms built on the same stem, and the near-meaning group lists other words for what is firm, narrow, or strict.
note.cn: 形近组收集同词干派生形式，近义组列出其它表示牢固、狭窄或严格的词。

entries.definition: in a firm and close way
to make or become tight
the state of being tight
a close-fitting garment covering the legs
entries.definitionCN: 紧身裤袜；只是同一词干的名词复数

solid and not easily moved
demanding obedience to rules

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the idea of close packing, from common phrases, and from the derived family.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从「挤紧」这一意象、常用短语与派生词族入手。

normal.en: Thight meant packed dense, so anything with no gap is tight.
normal.cn: thight 意为「挤得密」，所以凡是没缝隙的都可称 tight。

normal.en: Tighten is tight plus -en, the suffix of making.
normal.cn: tighten 是 tight 加 -en，即「使……」后缀。

normal.en: A tight schedule packs hours as a suitcase packs clothes.
normal.cn: 紧凑的日程把小时像行李箱塞衣服一样塞满。

normal.en: Sleep tight came from bedding pulled taut; the phrase survives after the bedstead.
normal.cn: sleep tight 原指把床绷紧的绳拉紧，床架没了短语还在。

normal.en: Tight control leaves no gap for a mistake to slip through.
normal.cn: tight control 不留缝隙，错误钻不进去。

abstract.en: Picture a drum skin: flat, taut, and every knock bounces straight back.
abstract.cn: 想象一面鼓皮：平整、绷紧，每一下敲击都笔直弹回。

abstract.en: Think of a lid pressed down until the air squeaks out at the rim.
abstract.cn: 想一只被压下去的盖子，边缘把空气挤得吱吱响。

abstract.en: A tight match is two hands gripping and neither letting go.
abstract.cn: 势均力敌的比赛就是两只手互相扣住，谁也不松。

examples.en: The lid is tight, so the jar will keep the coffee fresh.
examples.cn: 盖子很紧，罐子能让咖啡保持新鲜。

examples.en: She held the child's hand tight crossing the road.
examples.cn: 过马路时她紧紧握着孩子的手。

examples.en: The team worked to a tight deadline before the launch.
examples.cn: 上线前团队赶着非常紧的期限工作。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「太特」——绳子拉得太特别紧，一点都松不开。

root: 古英语 thight（密集的、坚实的），日耳曼语族固有词，与德语 dicht（密）同源；现代义「紧、严格、稀缺」皆由「挤紧无缝」引申。

sensesIntro.en: One core idea, packing with no slack, gives the entry its physical tightness, its strictness, its crowded schedules, its scarcity, and even its near-equal contests.
sensesIntro.cn: 「挤紧无余量」这一核心，给出了物理上的紧、规则上的严、日程上的满、物资上的缺，甚至势均力敌的比赛。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a rope or packed box with not one millimetre of slack.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根绳或一只箱子，挤得没有一毫米余量。

branches.en: Physical tightness of objects and clothes.
branches.cn: 物体与衣物的物理紧度。

branches.en: Tightness applied to rules and guarding.
branches.cn: 紧度用到规则与看管上。

branches.en: Packing in time, the manner of holding, and closeness of a contest.
branches.cn: 时间的挤满、握持的方式与比赛的接近。

branches.en: Tightness as shortage.
The informal sense of a packed, unsteady state.

intro.en: The word is a Germanic adjective; its endings are the productive English ones that build the adverb, verb, and noun.
intro.cn: 本词是日耳曼语形容词；其词尾是构成副词、动词与名词的能产英语后缀。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin etymon for tight, so the comparison list stays short and only offers borrowed near-synonyms.
latinIntro.cn: tight 没有拉丁词源，故对照表较短，只给出借入的近义词。

items.example: The root thight ends in this consonant cluster.
items.exampleCN: 词根 thight 以这组辅音收尾。

items.example: Tightly describes how something is held.
Tighten means to make tight.
Tightness measures how tight something is.
Tights names a garment covering both legs.
items.exampleCN: tights 指包住双腿的衣物。

items.meaning: used at the start of compounds
items.example: Tight-lipped means keeping a secret.
Untight is rare but understandable.

items.meaning: having a stated kind of fist
items.example: Tightfisted means unwilling to spend.

definition_zh: 紧紧地；牢牢地；严密地；严格地
definition_en: in a firm, close, or strictly controlled way, so that nothing is loose or gaps remain
core_image: 十指扣住栏杆，指节发白，手一点也不松
scene: 山风把帐篷吹得呼呼作响，绳子得再拉一遍。The ropes were pulled tightly across the pegs before the storm arrived.
sceneCN: 这里 tightly 是「紧紧地」（第 1 个义项：牢固、不松动）；句意为暴风雨来之前，绳子被紧紧拉过地钉。画面里有帐篷、地钉与绷直的绳。

pos.zh: 副词：紧紧地、牢牢地；严密地、严格地

derivatives.zh: 去掉 -ly 的原形容词，义为「紧的、绷紧的」
由形容词加 -en 构成，义为「收紧；使变紧」
由形容词加 -ness 构成，义为「紧；紧密程度」

senses.title: In a firm, close grip
senses.definition: with a firm hold that does not slip or loosen
senses.definitionCN: 以不会滑动或松开的牢固握持
senses.example: She held her hat tightly as the wind rose.
senses.exampleCN: 风起时她紧紧抓住帽子。
senses.why: The suffix -ly turns the adjective into a description of how an action is done, keeping the whole force of no slack.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -ly 把形容词变成「动作如何进行」的描述，同时保留了「无余量」的全部力度。

senses.title: So as to leave no gap
senses.definition: in a way that closes or seals something completely
senses.definitionCN: 把某物完全闭合或封住
senses.example: The windows were shut tightly against the dust.
senses.exampleCN: 窗户被严严实实地关上挡尘土。
senses.why: A closure that leaves no gap is the adverb form of the packed image.
senses.whyCN: 不缝隙的闭合，是「挤紧」意象的副词形式。

senses.title: In a packed or crowded way
senses.definition: so that things are pressed close together with little space
senses.definitionCN: 物件被挤得很近、几乎不留空间
senses.example: The passengers were tightly packed into the last bus.
senses.exampleCN: 乘客们被塞在末班车里，挤得满满当当。
senses.why: When things are packed with no room to move, the packing is described with this adverb.
senses.whyCN: 物件被挤得无从移动时，就用这个副词描述这种堆法。

senses.title: Under strict control
senses.definition: with strict rules, limits, or supervision
senses.definitionCN: 以严格的规则、限制或监督
senses.example: The chemical plant is tightly regulated.
senses.exampleCN: 这家化工厂受到严格监管。
senses.why: Rules with no looseness are described with the same adverb used for ropes.
senses.whyCN: 没有松懈的规矩，用与绳子同一个副词来描述。

senses.title: In a closely linked way
senses.definition: in a way that keeps people or things closely connected
senses.definitionCN: 使人或事物保持紧密联系的方式
senses.example: The small village is tightly knit around its fishing fleet.
senses.exampleCN: 这个小村庄围绕渔船队紧密相连。
senses.why: People bound as firmly as knotted rope are said to be tightly linked.
senses.whyCN: 像打结的绳一样绑紧的人们被称为紧密相连。

senses.title: With little time to spare
senses.definition: with very little space between events or deadlines
senses.definitionCN: 事件或期限之间几乎没有空档
senses.example: The two meetings were tightly scheduled back to back.
senses.exampleCN: 两场会议紧挨着排得满满当当。
senses.why: Hours packed without slack are described by the adverb of packing.
senses.whyCN: 小时被挤得没有空隙，就用「挤」的副词来描述。

senses.title: In a narrow, close result
senses.definition: in a way that shows only a small difference between sides
senses.definitionCN: 显示双方差距很小的方式
senses.example: The vote was tightly contested until the last district reported.
senses.exampleCN: 直到最后一个选区报出结果，这场投票都争夺得很接近。
senses.why: Two sides held close together hardly separate, and the adverb carries that closeness into the contest.
senses.whyCN: 双方贴近得几乎分不开，这个副词把这种贴近带进竞争里。

senses.title: With narrowed, narrowed eyes
senses.definition: used of eyes squeezed nearly shut
senses.definitionCN: 形容眼睛几乎闭合
senses.example: He listened with his eyes tightly shut.
senses.exampleCN: 他闭紧眼睛听。
senses.why: The same closing with no gap applies to eyelids, which also shut without slack.
senses.whyCN: 同样「合得无缝」也适用于眼睑，眼睑也能严丝合缝地闭上。

intro.en: The adverb is the adjective tight with the native suffix -ly, so its history follows the adjective once the ending is set.
intro.cn: 这个副词是形容词 tight 加本土后缀 -ly，所以结尾确定后，其历史就随形容词走。

items.en: The root thight already described what is dense and closely packed.
items.cn: 词根 thight 已用来形容密集、挤紧之物。

items.en: The adjective settles into the sense of firmly fixed, and adverbial use appears.
items.cn: 形容词定型为「固定牢靠」，副词用法随之出现。

items.en: The suffix -ly, from the Old English adjective ending -lic, becomes the regular adverb maker.
items.cn: 后缀 -ly 源自中古英语形容词词尾 -lic，成为常规的副词构成手段。

items.en: Tightly spreads to packed crowds, strict rules, and close schedules.
items.cn: tightly 扩展到拥挤人群、严格规则与紧凑日程。

items.en: Technical and official writing favours tightly controlled and tightly packed.
items.cn: 技术与官方写作常用 tightly controlled 与 tightly packed。

items.en: The adverb is now fully regular and has no separate lexical history.
items.cn: 这个副词如今完全规则化，没有独立的词义史。

note.en: The look-alikes are the adjective family behind the adverb, and the near-meaning group offers other adverbs of firmness.
note.cn: 形近组是其后的形容词词族，近义组给出其它表示牢固的副词。
