words printed under a picture
the state of legally owning something

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the Latin label, the legal sense, and the family of prefixes.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从拉丁语的「标签」、法律义与前缀词族入手。

normal.en: A title is a label written on something, whether a book or a person.
normal.cn: title 就是写在东西上的标签，无论是书还是人。

normal.en: Entitle is en- plus title, giving someone the title or right.
normal.cn: entitle 是 en- 加 title，给人头衔或资格。

normal.en: Subtitle is sub- plus title, a title under the title.
normal.cn: subtitle 是 sub- 加 title，标题下面的标题。

normal.en: Title matches both the book's name and the sentence's class name.
normal.cn: title 在语法里指书名，也指那个类别名。

normal.en: Title to land is a property right, not the name of the land.
normal.cn: title to land 是产权，不是土地的名字。

abstract.en: Picture gold letters pressed into a leather spine.
abstract.cn: 想象金字压进皮面书脊。

abstract.en: Think of a name card deliberately placed at the top of a page.
abstract.cn: 想一张名片被特意放在页首。

abstract.en: A champion's title is a crown made of letters.
abstract.cn: 冠军头衔就是一顶字母做成的王冠。

examples.en: The title of the book is printed on the spine.
examples.cn: 书名印在书脊上。

examples.en: She was given the title of professor last spring.
examples.cn: 去年春天她被授予教授头衔。

examples.en: He titled his talk Why Cities Sing.
examples.cn: 他把演讲题作「城市为何歌唱」。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「太头」——太头上那一行字，就是标题。

root: 拉丁语 titulus（铭文、标签、荣誉标志），经古法语进入英语，由「书写标记」引申出书名、头衔、所有权与冠军等义。

sensesIntro.en: A written label on a thing explains the whole entry: the name of a work, the name on its spine, the label on a person's status, the heading of a legal deed, and the champion's crown.
sensesIntro.cn: 写在物件上的标签贯穿全词：作品之名、书脊之名、身份之名、契据之标题，乃至冠军的名分。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a short inscription fixed to the front of something.
core.cn: 核心意象：贴在事物正面的一段简短铭文。

branches.en: Names of works and headings of documents.
Names that mark rank.
The name that proves ownership.
The name of the champion.
The act of writing the name.

intro.en: The stem is Latin for a label, so the affix work follows the borrowed titul- form and the English prefixes built on it.
intro.cn: 词干在拉丁语中意为标签，构词要点是借入的 titul- 形式与在其上构成的英语前缀。

latinIntro.en: The Latin list gives the label word and its own family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁表给出「标签」一词及其词族。

items.example: The stem runs through the whole family.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干贯穿整个词族。

items.example: Entitle gives someone a right or a name.
Subtitle sits under the main title.
Titled families hold noble ranks.
Titles serves as plural and verb form.
items.exampleCN: titles 既是复数也是动词形式。

items.example: Titling a paper takes thought.
items.exampleCN: titling 一篇论文需要动脑。

items.example: Titular means by title only.
A titleless page is hard to file.

definition_zh: 到；向；往；向……（表示方向）；给；对于；（不定式标记）
definition_en: a preposition of direction, destination, or receiver, and the marker placed before the basic form of a verb
core_image: 手指向一个方向，箭头正指着目的地
scene: 站台上的人都盯着远处那一点，等那列火车开过来。The crowd walked to the far end of the platform and waited.
sceneCN: 这里 to 是「往、到」（第 1 个义项：表示朝向或到达某处）；句意为人群走到站台尽头等着。画面有铁路、人群与远处车灯。

pos.zh: 介词：向、到、给、对于
副词：（门）关上；（恢复）清醒
助词：不定式标记

derivatives.zh: 加普通后缀 -ward 构成，义为「朝向」
toward 的英式变体，义为「朝向」
复合词，义为「在今天」
复合词，义为「今晚」

senses.title: Towards a place
senses.definition: in the direction of a place, with the idea of arrival
senses.definitionCN: 朝某地的方向，并含抵达之意
senses.example: They walked to the far end of the platform.
senses.exampleCN: 他们走到站台的另一端。
senses.why: The Old English preposition named motion toward a goal, and the goal being reached is the arrival sense.
senses.whyCN: 古英语介词表示朝目标移动，抵达目标便成了「到」的义。

senses.title: As far as
senses.definition: used to show the limit or end of a movement or range
senses.definitionCN: 表示移动或范围的终点
senses.example: The queue stretched from the gate to the corner.
senses.exampleCN: 队伍从大门一直排到街角。
senses.why: Direction plus limit gives a line that ends at a point.
senses.whyCN: 方向加界限，画出一条终于某点的线。

senses.title: The receiver of an action
senses.definition: used to introduce the person who receives something
senses.definitionCN: 用来引出接受某物的人
senses.example: Please give the letter to your teacher.
senses.exampleCN: 请把信交给你的老师。
senses.why: The goal of a movement is often a person, so the reaching word becomes the receiving word.
senses.whyCN: 移动目标常是一个人，因此「抵达」的词也成了「给予」的词。

senses.title: Showing a relationship
senses.definition: used to show a relationship between two things, such as comparison or attitude
senses.definitionCN: 表示两事物之间的关系，如比较或态度
senses.example: She is kind to strangers.
senses.exampleCN: 她对陌生人很和善。
senses.why: The goal of an attitude is the person or thing it is directed at.
senses.whyCN: 态度的指向就是它所对着的人或物。

senses.title: Telling the time
senses.definition: used in clock readings before the next hour
senses.definitionCN: 钟点表达中用于下一个整点之前
senses.example: It is ten to six.
senses.exampleCN: 现在五点五十（差十分六点）。
senses.why: Counting forward toward the coming hour is the direction sense applied to the clock face.
senses.whyCN: 朝着下一个小时数下去，就是方向义用在钟面上。

senses.title: Before the basic verb
senses.definition: the marker used before the basic form of a verb
senses.definitionCN: 放在动词原形前的标记
senses.example: He wants to leave now.
senses.exampleCN: 他现在想走。
senses.why: The old preposition of direction was placed before a verb to show the intended action, and became the infinitive marker.
senses.whyCN: 古英语表示方向的介词被放在动词前表示打算做的动作，后来成为不定式标记。

senses.title: Showing purpose
senses.definition: used to state the purpose of an action
senses.definitionCN: 用来说明动作的目的
senses.example: She came to say goodbye.
senses.exampleCN: 她是来道别的。
senses.why: Reaching toward an aim is the same movement, now aimed at an act rather than a place.
senses.whyCN: 朝目标抵达的同一动作，此时目标是个行为而非地点。

senses.title: Closed or shut
senses.definition: used with door in the phrase to after door to mean shut
senses.definitionCN: 与门连用，表示关严
senses.example: Pull the door to when you leave.
senses.exampleCN: 离开时把门带上。
senses.why: Something that has moved right up to its frame is wholly closed.
senses.whyCN: 完全抵到门框的东西就彻底关上了。

senses.title: To and fro
senses.definition: used in the phrase to and fro for back-and-forth movement
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语 to and fro，表示来回移动
senses.example: The pendulum swung to and fro.
senses.exampleCN: 钟摆来回摆动。
senses.why: Two opposite direction words paired give movement that never settles.
senses.whyCN: 两个相反方向的词配对，得到永远停不下的移动。

senses.title: According to
senses.definition: used in the phrase according to for a source of information
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语 according to，表示信息来源
senses.example: According to the notice, the hall is closed.
senses.exampleCN: 根据告示，礼堂关闭。
senses.why: The information is measured against its source, which is the limit sense again.
senses.whyCN: 信息以其来源为界，又是界限义。

intro.en: The word is one of the oldest in the language, an Old English preposition of direction related to forms in other Germanic languages.
intro.cn: 这是语言中最古老的词之一，古英语中介词表示方向，与其它日耳曼语中的形式同源。

items.en: To meant toward, and also served to mark the person a thing was given to.
items.cn: 古英语 to 意为「朝向」，也用来标记接受某物的人。

items.en: Cognate forms in other Germanic languages carry the same direction sense.
items.cn: 其它日耳曼语中的同源形式带有同样的方向义。

items.en: The preposition was already used before a verb to express purpose.
items.cn: 这个介词已在动词前使用以表达目的。

items.en: Unstressed forms of the infinitive marker develop, giving the modern part of to.
items.cn: 不定式标记的弱读形式出现，成为现代 to 的一部分。

definition_zh: 烤面包；吐司；祝酒；敬酒；烘烤；为……干杯
definition_en: bread browned by heat; also the act of drinking in honour of someone, and to brown food, or to honour a person with a drink
core_image: 面包片贴在火边，边沿渐渐焦成金黄
scene: 桌边坐满了人，杯子一只只被举起来。The guests raised their glasses to toast the bride and groom.
sceneCN: 这里 toast 是「为……祝酒」（第 4 个义项：举杯向某人致敬）；句意为宾客举杯向新娘新郎祝酒。画面有玻璃杯、长桌与烛光。

pos.zh: 名词：烤面包；祝酒；敬酒
动词：烘烤；为……干杯

derivatives.zh: 加过去分词结尾，义为「烤过的」

senses.title: Browned bread
senses.definition: bread browned by heat, eaten hot with butter or jam
senses.definitionCN: 经加热变褐的面包，配黄油或果酱趁热吃
senses.example: He had toast and eggs for breakfast.
senses.exampleCN: 他早饭吃了烤面包和鸡蛋。
senses.why: The word comes from the Latin for parched or roasted, and bread is the first thing dried by fire.
senses.whyCN: 本词来自拉丁语「烘烤、干炒」，而最先被火烘的是面包。

senses.title: To brown food by heat
senses.definition: to heat bread or other food until it browns
senses.definitionCN: 加热面包或其它食物至变褐
senses.example: She toasted the nuts in a dry pan.
senses.exampleCN: 她在干锅里把坚果烤香。
senses.why: The verb is the fire's action, with bread as its most common object.
senses.whyCN: 动词是火的动作，最常见的作用对象是面包。

senses.title: A call to drink in honour
senses.definition: the act of asking people to drink in honour of someone
senses.definitionCN: 请众人举杯向某人致敬的行为
senses.example: He proposed a toast to the new team.
senses.exampleCN: 他提议为新团队干杯。
senses.why: Flavoured toast was once put in the wine, so the honoured name and the toasted bread share one word.
senses.whyCN: 从前酒中会放入带味的烤面包，被致敬的名字与烤面包因此共用一个词。

senses.title: To honour with a drink
senses.definition: to raise a glass and drink in honour of a person or event
senses.definitionCN: 举杯饮酒向某人或某事致敬
senses.example: The guests toasted the bride and groom.
senses.exampleCN: 宾客向新娘新郎祝酒。
senses.why: The noun of honouring turns into the action of raising the glass.
senses.whyCN: 致敬的名词变成举杯的动作。

senses.title: A popular figure
senses.definition: a person who is widely praised or celebrated in a group
senses.definitionCN: 在群体中广受赞扬或追捧的人
senses.example: After the rescue he was the toast of the town.
senses.exampleCN: 救人之后他成了全城称颂的人物。
senses.why: The person toasted is the one at whom every glass is raised.
senses.whyCN: 被祝酒的人就是所有杯子对着的那一位。

senses.title: To make warm
senses.definition: to warm oneself or something thoroughly by a fire
senses.definitionCN: 在火边把身体或物件烤暖
senses.example: They toasted their feet by the stove.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在炉边烘脚取暖。
senses.why: Heat that browns bread also warms a cold body, so the same verb covers comfort.
senses.whyCN: 让面包变褐的热也能暖身，于是同一动词兼指暖和。

senses.title: Burnt or overdone
senses.definition: used to describe bread browned too far or a plan ruined
senses.definitionCN: 形容面包烤得过火，或计划泡汤
senses.example: The toast was black at the edges.
senses.exampleCN: 面包片边缘都烤黑了。
senses.why: The same heat taken too far is the other side of the browning.
senses.whyCN: 同样的热走到过头，就是变褐的反面。

senses.title: The proposed salute
senses.definition: the short speech that accompanies a toast
senses.definitionCN: 伴随祝酒的一小段讲话
senses.example: Her toast at the dinner was only two sentences long.
senses.exampleCN: 她在晚宴上的祝酒词只有两句。
senses.why: A toast is both the drink and the words that go with it.
senses.whyCN: toast 既指这杯酒，也指与它同来的话。

intro.en: The word comes from Latin through French: torrere meant to parch or roast, and the dish and the honour began with toasted bread floated in wine.
intro.cn: 本词经法语来自拉丁语：torrere 意为烘干、烤，菜与敬酒都始于浮在酒中的烤面包。

items.en: Torrere meant to burn, parch, or roast.
items.cn: torrere 意为烧、烘干、烤。

items.en: Toster named the action of browning bread by heat.
items.cn: toster 指用火把面包烤成褐色。

items.en: The word enters English with the roast sense and quickly names the food itself.
items.cn: 本词以「烘烤」义进入英语，很快兼指食物本身。

items.en: In the custom of the time, spiced toast was floated in the wine.
items.cn: 当时的风俗是在酒中浮一片加香料的烤面包。

items.en: By the eighteenth century the honoured person and the cup share the word toast.
items.cn: 到十八世纪，被致敬的人与这只杯子共用一个词。

items.en: The verb extends to browning nuts and to warming feet by a fire.
items.cn: 动词扩展到烘坚果以及炉边烘脚取暖。

note.cn: 形近组收集同词干构成的厨房用词，近义组列出烘烤与饮酒相关的词。

normal.en: The toast of the town is the person everyone drinks to.

normal.en: Toasted and toasty split: food is toasted, a warm room is toasty.
normal.cn: toasted 用于食物，toasty 用于暖烘烘的房间。

abstract.cn: 想一片面包边缘转成金黄。

abstract.en: Think of glasses meeting above a table while a name is spoken.
abstract.cn: 想名字被念出时，桌上杯子相碰。

abstract.en: One warm word covers both a kitchen fire and a room's affection.
abstract.cn: 同一个温暖的词，既指厨房的火，也指满桌的情谊。

examples.cn: 她吃了抹蜂蜜的烤面包，喝了一杯牛奶。

examples.en: We toasted the walnuts in a dry pan for a minute.
examples.cn: 我们用干锅把核桃烘了一分钟。

definition_zh: 今天；今日；现今；当今；现在
definition_en: on or during the present day; also at the present period of history
core_image: 日历上被圈住的那一格，正是眼前这一天
scene: 窗外的树影还在原来的位置，只是叶子又落了一些。Today is warmer than yesterday, so the windows are open.
sceneCN: 这里 today 是「今天」（第 1 个义项：当前这一天）；句意为今天比昨天暖和，所以窗户都开着。画面有开着的窗、树影与日历。

pos.zh: 名词：今天；现今
副词：在今天；现今

derivatives.zh: 加所有格结尾，义为「今天的」
同构复合词，义为「今晚」
同族时间副词，义为「明天」

senses.title: The present day
senses.definition: the day on which someone is speaking or acting
senses.definitionCN: 说话或行动所处的这一天
senses.example: Today is warmer than yesterday.
senses.exampleCN: 今天比昨天暖和。
senses.why: The word is a compound of to and day, literally on this day, first written as two words.
senses.whyCN: 本词由 to 与 day 复合而成，字面即「在这一天」，最初分写。

senses.title: On this day, as an adverb
senses.definition: during the present day, used to place an action in time
senses.definitionCN: 把动作定位在当日
senses.example: We are meeting the teacher today.
senses.exampleCN: 我们今天见老师。
senses.why: The same compound works as a time adverb without any preposition in front.
senses.whyCN: 同一复合词可作时间副词，前面不再需要介词。

senses.title: The present period
senses.definition: the present era or the current state of affairs
senses.definitionCN: 当前的年代或事务状况
senses.example: Today's students learn with devices in hand.
senses.exampleCN: 当今的学生手里拿着设备学习。
senses.why: A single day expands by metaphor to an age, since the present moment is felt as one long day.
senses.whyCN: 一天由比喻扩展为一个时代，因为当下被感知为漫长的一天。

senses.title: Nowadays
senses.definition: in the present time as compared with the past
senses.definitionCN: 与过去相比的现在
senses.example: Jobs today demand more flexibility than a century ago.
senses.exampleCN: 如今的工作比一个世纪前需要更多灵活性。
senses.why: Comparing past and present turns one day into a standpoint from which history is viewed.
senses.whyCN: 过去与现在的对照，把一天变成了观看历史的立场。

senses.title: Modern times
senses.definition: the modern period, especially in political or social writing
senses.definitionCN: 尤见于政治与社会写作中的现代
senses.example: Today differs from the past in how news travels.
senses.exampleCN: 今与昔的差别在于消息如何传播。
senses.why: Once today means the age, it can serve as a label for a whole social condition.
senses.whyCN: 一旦 today 指这个时代，就可作为整个社会状况的标签。

senses.title: The day in question
senses.definition: used of the day being discussed in a narrative
senses.definitionCN: 叙事中正在讨论的那一天
senses.example: They arrived on the morning of today's story.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在故事当天的早上到达。
senses.why: In a reported context, today is shifted to the day the speaker marked.
senses.whyCN: 在转述语境中，today 会移到说话者所指的那一天。

senses.title: Today's issue
senses.definition: used for a current item, as in today's agenda
senses.definitionCN: 用于当前事项，如 today's agenda
senses.example: Today's business is the budget.
senses.exampleCN: 今天的议程是预算。
senses.why: A dated item belongs to today by definition, so the word labels what is current.
senses.whyCN: 当日之事自然属于今天，于是本词用来标示当下。

senses.title: An exclamation
senses.definition: used alone to mark that the day is the appointed time
senses.definitionCN: 单独使用，表示所定的日子就是今天
senses.example: Today! The shop opens at last.
senses.exampleCN: 就在今天！店终于开了。
senses.why: Public announcements reuse the single day word as a dramatic marker.
senses.whyCN: 公告把这一天一词用作戏剧性的标记。

intro.en: It is a native English compound of to and day, written first as to day and joined in the seventeenth century.
intro.cn: 这是英语本土复合词，由 to 与 day 构成，起初写作 to day，十七世纪合为一词。

items.en: To meant at or on in certain time phrases, and daeg meant day.
items.cn: 古英语 to 在某些时间短语中意为「在」，daeg 意为「一天」。

items.en: The phrase to day appears written as two words meaning on this day.
items.cn: to day 一语出现，分写，意为「在这一天」。

items.en: The compound begins to be treated as a single word.
items.cn: 这个复合词开始被当作一个词处理。

items.en: The spelling today with one word becomes standard.
items.cn: 合写形式 today 成为标准。

items.en: The word extends from the day to the present age.
items.cn: 本词从这一天扩展到当今时代。

items.en: Tonight and tomorrow follow the same compound pattern.
items.cn: tonight 与 tomorrow 遵循同样的复合方式。

normal.en: Today is to plus day, meaning on this day.
normal.cn: today 是 to 加 day，意为在这一天。

normal.en: Tonight and tomorrow are built the same way, so learn all three together.
normal.cn: tonight、tomorrow 同法构成，三个一起记。

normal.en: Today's world uses today as an age, not just a day.
normal.cn: today's world 里的 today 指一个时代，而不只是一天。

normal.cn: today's 里的撇号是时间所有格，不是缩略。

normal.en: Comparing with yesterday turns today into a standpoint.
normal.cn: 与 yesterday 对比，today 就成了一个立场。

abstract.en: Picture a calendar square circled once in red.
abstract.cn: 想象日历上一格用红笔圈了一次。

abstract.en: Think of a window open to the morning air.

abstract.en: Every age calls itself today while it lasts.
abstract.cn: 每个时代在它存在时都自称今天。

examples.en: Today is the first day of the new term.
examples.cn: 今天是新学期的第一天。

examples.en: She bought today's paper on the way home.
examples.cn: 回家路上她买了今天的报纸。

examples.en: Today, most letters are read on a screen.
examples.cn: 如今大多数信件都在屏幕上读。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「特得」——特别得到了一天，就是今天。

definition_zh: 脚趾；足尖；鞋头；用脚尖碰；遵守（规则）
definition_en: one of the five parts at the end of the foot; the front part of a shoe; also to touch with the toes or to conform to a rule
core_image: 一只赤脚踩在沙上，留下五个浅浅的趾印
scene: 舞者在木地板上把重心慢慢移到脚尖。She stood on her toes to reach the top shelf.
sceneCN: 这里 toe 是「脚趾／足尖」（第 1 个义项：脚末端的五个部分）；句意为她踮起脚去够最上层的架子。画面有木地板、高架子与伸直的脚背。

pos.zh: 名词：脚趾；足尖；鞋头
动词：用脚尖碰；遵守（toe the line）

derivatives.zh: 加过去分词结尾，义为「有……趾的」（如 two-toed）
复合词，义为「踮脚走」
复合词，义为「脚趾甲」
加 -less 构成，义为「无脚趾的」

senses.title: A digit of the foot
senses.definition: one of the five separate parts at the end of the human foot
senses.definitionCN: 人脚末端的五个分开部分之一
senses.example: He stubbed his toe on the step.
senses.exampleCN: 他在台阶上撞到了脚趾。
senses.why: The Old English word ta meant the toe, and it is one of the oldest body words in the language.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 tá 指脚趾，是语言中最古老的身体词之一。

senses.title: The front of the foot
senses.definition: the front part of the foot as a whole
senses.definitionCN: 脚的整个前部
senses.example: She stood on her toes to reach the shelf.
senses.exampleCN: 她踮起脚去够架子。
senses.why: The toes together form the front edge of the foot, and that edge takes the name.
senses.whyCN: 五趾合起来构成脚的前缘，这个前缘也借用了该词。

senses.title: The front of a shoe
senses.definition: the part of a shoe that covers the toes
senses.definitionCN: 鞋子覆盖脚趾的前部
senses.example: The toe of his boot was scuffed.
senses.exampleCN: 他的靴子头磨花了。
senses.why: What covers the toes is named after them, as with many garments.
senses.whyCN: 覆盖脚趾的部分以脚趾命名，许多衣物都如此。

senses.title: To touch with the toes
senses.definition: to touch or kick something with the toes
senses.definitionCN: 用脚趾触碰或踢某物
senses.example: He toed the ball gently back to the child.
senses.exampleCN: 他轻轻用脚尖把球拨回给孩子。
senses.why: The body part becomes a verb of contact, as hand does in handing.
senses.whyCN: 身体部位变成表示接触的动词，正如 hand 变成 handing。

senses.title: To comply with rules
senses.definition: to obey the rules, especially in toe the line
senses.definitionCN: 遵守规则，尤见于 toe the line
senses.example: New staff soon learn to toe the line.
senses.exampleCN: 新员工很快学会守规矩。
senses.why: The phrase comes from standing with the toes on a marked line, a picture of obedience.
senses.whyCN: 这一短语来自把脚尖踩在标线上的站姿，是一幅顺从的图景。

senses.title: Close attention
senses.definition: used in on one's toes for being alert and ready
senses.definitionCN: 用于 on one's toes，表示警觉、准备好
senses.example: The fast pace kept the whole team on their toes.
senses.exampleCN: 快节奏让整个团队都保持着警觉。
senses.why: Someone on the toes is ready to move at once, unlike one standing flat.
senses.whyCN: 脚尖着地的人随时能起步，与平脚站立者不同。

senses.title: Complete extent
senses.definition: used in from head to toe for the whole body
senses.definitionCN: 用于 from head to toe，表示全身
senses.example: They were covered in mud from head to toe.
senses.exampleCN: 他们从头到脚都是泥。
senses.why: Head and toe mark the two ends of the body, so the phrase names the whole between them.
senses.whyCN: 头与脚标出身体的两端，短语便指两者的整体。

senses.title: To offend someone
senses.definition: used in step on someone's toes for offending or intruding
senses.definitionCN: 用于 step on someone's toes，表示得罪或越界
senses.example: Be careful not to step on the manager's toes.
senses.exampleCN: 小心别踩到经理的痛处。
senses.why: A literal foot on another's toes becomes the picture of a small, felt intrusion.
senses.whyCN: 一只脚真踩在别人脚趾上，就成了被真切感到的冒犯。

senses.title: A projecting part
senses.definition: a part of an object that sticks out at the bottom or front
senses.definitionCN: 物体底部或前部突出的部分
senses.example: The toe of the wall had crumbled away.
senses.exampleCN: 墙脚已经剥落。
senses.why: Any projecting foot-like end borrows the body word, as in the toe of a slope.
senses.whyCN: 任何像脚一样突出的末端都借用这个身体词，如坡脚。

intro.en: The word is native and very old, appearing in Old English as ta with the same meaning, and it has stayed close to the body throughout.
intro.cn: 这是个古老的本土词，古英语已作 tá，义为脚趾，千百年来始终贴近身体。

items.en: Ta named a toe of the foot, a short and ancient word.
items.cn: tá 指脚趾，是个短小而古老的词。

items.en: Cognate forms in other Germanic languages mean toe or finger.
items.cn: 其它日耳曼语中的同源形式表示脚趾或手指。

items.en: The sense extends from the digit to the front of the foot and of a shoe.
items.cn: 词义从脚趾扩展到脚的前部与鞋头。

items.en: Toe the line enters from drill and racing, where the toes must touch a mark.
items.cn: toe the line 源自操练与赛跑，脚尖必须踏在标记上。

items.en: On one's toes and from head to toe become standard idioms.
items.cn: on one's toes 与 from head to toe 成为标准习语。

items.en: The word extends to projecting ends of objects such as slopes and walls.
items.cn: 本词扩展到斜坡、墙脚等物体的突出端部。

note.cn: 形近组收集复合词与形近词，近义组列出相近的身体部位词。

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the body part, the line-standing picture, and the compounds.

normal.en: Toe the line pictures toes touching a painted mark, which is how obedience is drawn.
normal.cn: toe the line 让人想到脚尖踩在画好的线上，正是顺从的图像。

normal.en: On your toes is the alert posture, ready to move.
normal.cn: on your toes 就是随时起步的警备姿态。

normal.en: Toenail and tiptoe are toe plus an ordinary word.
normal.cn: toenail 与 tiptoe 都是 toe 加常用词。

normal.en: Toed describes feet by number of toes, as in two-toed.
normal.cn: toed 用于按趾数描述脚，如 two-toed。

normal.en: The toe of a shoe, slope, or wall all stick out like a foot.
normal.cn: 鞋头、坡脚、墙脚都像脚一样突出。

abstract.en: Picture five small dents in wet sand.
abstract.cn: 想湿沙上五个小小的凹痕。

abstract.en: Think of a dancer rising onto the very tips of the feet.
abstract.cn: 想舞者升到脚的最尖端。

abstract.en: A wall's toe is the same shape as your toe, only huge.
abstract.cn: 墙脚与你的脚趾形状相同，只是巨大得多。

examples.en: He broke the middle toe of his left foot.
examples.cn: 他左脚中趾骨折了。

examples.en: The children were told to toe the line during assembly.
examples.cn: 集会时孩子们被告知要守规矩。

examples.en: Mud covered her shoes from toe to heel.
examples.cn: 泥把她鞋子的前后都糊满了。

sensesIntro.cn: 身体上最小的趾给了本词脚前部与鞋头义、触碰与顺从的动词义，以及警觉与整体的习语义。

definition_zh: 一起；共同；合起来；连续地；（get together）聚会
definition_en: with another person or thing, in one place or as one group; also in an unbroken sequence
core_image: 两双手伸到一处，掌与掌合拢成一点
scene: 晚饭前，桌上的碗筷被一只只摆好，孩子在旁边帮忙。The family put the table together before dinner.
sceneCN: 这里 together 是「一起、共同」（第 1 个义项：与他人或他物相聚一处）；句意为一家人在晚饭前一起把桌子拼好。画面有桌面、碗筷与帮忙的孩子。

pos.zh: 副词：一起；共同；合起来；连续地

derivatives.zh: 加 -ness 构成，义为「亲密；团结」
加前缀 al- 变体构成，义为「完全；总共」
复合词，义为「聚会」

senses.title: With one another
senses.definition: with another person or group, in each other's company
senses.definitionCN: 与他人或群体在一处、同在一行
senses.example: They worked together all afternoon.
senses.exampleCN: 他们整个下午一起工作。
senses.why: Old English togædere was a phrase meaning to and in a gathering, that is, into one place.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 togædere 意为「聚到一处」，即合成一个地方。

senses.title: In one place or whole
senses.definition: so as to form one group, set, or whole
senses.definitionCN: 聚成一群、一套或一个整体
senses.example: She tied the branches together.
senses.exampleCN: 她把树枝捆在一起。
senses.why: The gathering sense becomes the act of joining parts into a unit.
senses.whyCN: 「聚拢」义延伸为把部分合成整体。

senses.title: In cooperation
senses.definition: in shared effort toward a common aim
senses.definitionCN: 为共同目标协作
senses.example: The whole street pulled together during the flood.
senses.exampleCN: 洪水期间整条街的人齐心协力。
senses.why: People who are physically gathered can act as one, and the word marks that shared effort.
senses.whyCN: 身体聚在一处的人可以一起行动，本词便标示这种共同用力。

senses.title: In continuous succession
senses.definition: used with plural time words for an unbroken run
senses.definitionCN: 与表示时段的复数连用，指不间断的一段
senses.example: It rained for three days together.
senses.exampleCN: 雨连续下了三天。
senses.why: Things placed one after another without a gap are together in a row as well as in space.
senses.whyCN: 彼此紧挨、无缝排列的东西，在时间上也是连着的一串。

senses.title: To assemble
senses.definition: used with put to make or assemble something from parts
senses.definitionCN: 与 put 连用，指由零件组成
senses.example: He put the shelf together in an hour.
senses.exampleCN: 他一小时就把架子组装好了。
senses.why: Assembling is the literal gathering of parts into one object.
senses.whyCN: 组装就是把零件真正聚成一个物件。

senses.title: In company with
senses.definition: used in together with to add something to what is already stated
senses.definitionCN: 用于 together with，把某物加上去
senses.example: The rent, together with heating, comes to a thousand.
senses.exampleCN: 房租加取暖费一共一千。
senses.why: Adding to a group is gathering the new item into the existing set.
senses.whyCN: 加入群体就是把新项聚进已有的集合。

senses.title: In harmony
senses.definition: in agreement or well matched
senses.definitionCN: 和谐、相配、一致
senses.example: The colours in the room go together well.
senses.exampleCN: 房间里的颜色很协调。
senses.why: Two things that fit join without a seam, which is gathering without friction.
senses.whyCN: 相配的两物无缝相接，正是无摩擦的聚合。

senses.title: The act of meeting
senses.definition: used in get-together for a social meeting
senses.definitionCN: 用于 get-together，指社交聚会
senses.example: A small get-together was held after the ceremony.
senses.exampleCN: 典礼后举行了一场小型聚会。
senses.why: The adverb becomes a noun in the compound, naming the meeting it describes.
senses.whyCN: 副词在复合词中变作名词，命名其所描述的会面。

intro.en: Old English had togædere, built from to and a form of gathering, so the original picture is movement into one place.
intro.cn: 古英语已有 togædere，由 to 与表示聚集的成分构成，原图景是「聚到一处」。

items.en: Togædere meant into one place, in a body.
items.cn: togædere 意为聚到一处、在一体之中。

items.en: The second element is related to gathering, giving the whole word a pull inward.
items.cn: 第二成分与「聚集」相关，使整词带有向内收拢的意思。

items.en: The form settles toward together, dropping the older ending.
items.cn: 形式趋于 together，古旧词尾脱落。

items.en: The word extends from place to shared action.
items.cn: 本词从地点扩展到共同行动。

items.en: The phrase for days together develops for continuous periods.
items.cn: for days together 这样的短语发展出「连续时段」义。

items.en: Togetherness appears as a noun for the feeling of closeness.
items.cn: togetherness 作为名词出现，指亲密之感。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers its derived and near forms, and the near-meaning group lists other words for joint action.
note.cn: 形近组收集派生与相近形式，近义组列出表示共同行动的其他词。

normal.en: Together is to plus gather, the two halves of pulling things in.
normal.cn: together 是 to 加 gather，两半合起来就是向内收拢。

normal.en: Get together, pull together, put together all add a verb of motion.
normal.cn: get together、pull together、put together 都叠加了动作动词。

normal.en: Together with adds an item; altogether means completely.
normal.cn: together with 是加上一项，altogether 是完全、总共。

normal.en: For days together marks an unbroken run of time.
normal.cn: for days together 标记连续不断的一段时间。

normal.en: Togetherness turns the adverb into a quality of a group.
normal.cn: togetherness 把副词变成群体的品性。

abstract.en: Picture two hands meeting at a single point.
abstract.cn: 想象两只手在一点上合拢。

abstract.en: Think of two branches bound with one cord.
abstract.cn: 想两根树枝被一根绳捆在一起。

abstract.en: A whole street pulling a rope is the word in action.
abstract.cn: 整条街的人拉一根绳，就是这个词的具体画面。

examples.en: We studied together in the library.
examples.cn: 我们一起在图书馆学习。

examples.en: He tied the papers together with string.
examples.cn: 他用绳子把文件捆在一起。

examples.en: The rain lasted for two weeks together.
examples.cn: 雨连续下了两个星期。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「特该的」——特别该在一起，谁也分不开。

sensesIntro.en: One pull into a single place explains company, combination, cooperation, unbroken runs, assembly, added items, harmony, and the noun for a meeting.

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two hands meeting and closing round the same object.
core.cn: 核心意象：两只手伸来，合握住同一件东西。

branches.en: Being in each other's company.

branches.cn: 把部分连成一体并组装。

definition_zh: 厕所；卫生间；马桶；梳洗（旧义）；梳妆打扮
definition_en: a room or fixture used for getting rid of bodily waste; earlier, the act of washing and dressing
core_image: 一扇关着的小门，门后有洗手池与一口便器
scene: 走廊尽头有一扇米色的小门，门牌上写着简单的字样。The toilet is at the end of the corridor, past the stairs.
sceneCN: 这里 toilet 是「厕所、卫生间」（第 1 个义项：排便的房间）；句意为厕所在走廊尽头、过楼梯便是。画面有米色门、走廊与指示牌。

pos.zh: 名词：厕所；卫生间；马桶；梳洗

derivatives.zh: 由 toiletry 复数构成，义为「洗漱用品」
借自法语的变体，义为「梳妆；打扮」
加 -ing 名词化，义为「如厕（护理用语）」

senses.title: The act of washing and dressing
senses.definition: the act or process of washing, grooming, and dressing oneself
senses.definitionCN: 洗涤、整理仪容与穿衣的过程
senses.example: She completed her toilet in a few quiet minutes.
senses.exampleCN: 她安静地几分钟就梳洗完毕。
senses.why: The word is a French diminutive of toile, a cloth, so it first meant the little cloth of the dressing table.
senses.whyCN: 本词是法语 toile（布）的指小形式，最初指梳妆台上的小布。

senses.title: The room for waste
senses.definition: a room containing a fixture for urinating and defecating
senses.definitionCN: 设有便器供排便的房间
senses.example: The toilet is at the end of the corridor.
senses.exampleCN: 厕所在走廊尽头。
senses.why: Indoor plumbing moved dressing and washing together with waste removal, and the room took the older word.
senses.whyCN: 室内管道把梳洗与排泄设施放在一处，房间便沿用了旧名。

senses.title: The fixture itself
senses.definition: the bowl-like fixture connected to a drain
senses.definitionCN: 与排水相连的便器
senses.example: The toilet was blocked by paper.
senses.exampleCN: 马桶被纸堵住了。
senses.why: The name of the room moves to the object inside it, a common metonymy.
senses.whyCN: 房间之名移到房间内的物件上，是一种常见的转喻。

senses.title: Toilet paper
senses.definition: the absorbent paper kept beside the fixture
senses.definitionCN: 便器旁备用的吸水纸
senses.example: They ran out of toilet paper.
senses.exampleCN: 他们的卫生纸用完了。
senses.why: The fixture names its own accessories, as with many household goods.
senses.whyCN: 便器命名了自己的配套用品，许多家居物都是如此。

senses.title: Grooming objects
senses.definition: articles used for washing and dressing, now mainly in toiletries
senses.definitionCN: 梳洗打扮用的小物件，现多见于 toiletries
senses.example: Her toilet bag held soap and a brush.
senses.exampleCN: 她的洗漱包里放着肥皂和刷子。
senses.why: From the act of dressing, the implements of the act also took the word.
senses.whyCN: 由打扮这一行为，其用具也借用了这个词。

senses.title: A public convenience
senses.definition: a public building or facility provided for the same purpose
senses.definitionCN: 同一用途的公共建筑或设施
senses.example: A sign pointed to the public toilets.
senses.exampleCN: 一块牌子指向公共厕所。
senses.why: Civic provision turns the private room into a public facility with the same name.
senses.whyCN: 市政设施把私人房间变成同名的公共设施。

senses.title: A dressing room
senses.definition: a private room where one washes and dresses, now old-fashioned
senses.definitionCN: 私人洗漱更衣的房间，今属旧用法
senses.example: The lady retired to her toilet before dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 这位女士晚宴前去梳妆室整理。
senses.why: The oldest room sense was about dressing, not waste, which is why the word still sounds formal.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的房间义是打扮之所而非排泄之所，因此本词至今带书面语感。

senses.title: A euphemism for the bathroom
senses.definition: used politely in place of a blunter word for the same place
senses.definitionCN: 用来委婉替代更直白的同义词
senses.example: Excuse me, where is the toilet?
senses.exampleCN: 劳驾，洗手间在哪里？
senses.why: Politeness keeps replacing toilet with softer words, and each new term quietly ages.
senses.whyCN: 礼貌不断用更柔和的词替换 toilet，而每个新词也悄悄变旧。

intro.en: It begins as a small cloth: French toile meant cloth, and toilette named the cloth on a dressing table, then the table, then the whole act of dressing.
intro.cn: 它起于一块小布：法语 toile 意为布，toilette 指梳妆台上那块布，继而指梳妆台，再指整套梳洗打扮。

items.en: Toile meant cloth, from Latin tela, a web or woven fabric.
items.cn: toile 意为布，来自拉丁语 tela（网、织物）。

items.en: Toilette, a diminutive, named the little cloth laid on a dressing table.
items.cn: 指小形式 toilette 指铺在梳妆台上的小布。

items.en: English borrows toilette for the act and place of dressing.
items.cn: 十七世纪英语借入 toilette，指打扮的行为与处所。

items.en: Toilet shifts to the room and its washing arrangements.
items.cn: toilet 转向房间及其洗漱设施。

items.en: With indoor plumbing the word attaches to the waste room and fixture.
items.cn: 随室内管道普及，本词附着于排泄房间与便器。

items.en: American usage prefers bathroom or restroom, British keeps toilet.
items.cn: 美式多用 bathroom、restroom，英式仍用 toilet。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the word's forms and French relatives, and the near-meaning group lists bathroom and grooming terms.
note.cn: 形近组收集本词形式与法语近亲，近义组列出浴室与梳洗类词。

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the little cloth, the dressing table, and the long journey to the modern room.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从那一小块布、梳妆台以及辗转至今的漫长路径入手。

normal.en: Toilet began as a little cloth and ended as a room, a story of borrowing.
normal.cn: toilet 由一小块布变成一间屋子，是一段借词的漂流史。

normal.en: Toiletries are still the cloth's descendants: washing and grooming goods.
normal.cn: toiletries 仍是那块布的后代：洗漱用品。

normal.en: British toilet, American bathroom and restroom name the same door.
normal.cn: 英式 toilet 与美式 bathroom、restroom 指同一扇门。

normal.en: The -ette ending means small, as in cigarette and kitchenette.
normal.cn: -ette 结尾表示「小」，如 cigarette、kitchenette。

normal.en: Flush the toilet uses the verb of rushing water.
normal.cn: flush the toilet 用了水流冲走的动词。

abstract.en: Picture a folded cloth on a wooden dressing table.
abstract.cn: 想象木梳妆台上一块叠好的布。

abstract.en: Think of a door marked simply Toilet at the end of a hall.
abstract.cn: 想走廊尽头一扇只写着 Toilet 的门。

abstract.en: Every polite word for the room spends a century and then goes stale.
abstract.cn: 每一个礼貌的称呼花掉一百年，然后变旧。

examples.en: The toilet is just past the kitchen.
examples.cn: 厕所就在厨房过去一点。

examples.en: Please flush the toilet after use.
examples.cn: 用后请冲马桶。

examples.en: She packed her toilet bag for the trip.
examples.cn: 她为旅行收拾好了洗漱包。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「脱衣累特」——脱衣时特别累，先去厕所歇一下。

root: 法语 toile（布，源自拉丁 tela 织物）的指小形式 toilette，先指梳妆台上的小布，再指梳妆、打扮与梳妆室，十九世纪随室内管道转指厕所与便器。

sensesIntro.en: A dressing-table cloth became an act, then a room for dressing, then a room for waste, then the fixture inside it, and finally a word polite enough to be replaced again.
sensesIntro.cn: 梳妆台上的一块布成为行为，成为更衣的房间，成为排泄的房间，再成为其中的便器，最后成为一个礼貌到又被替换掉的词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small cloth laid on a dressing table.
core.cn: 核心意象：梳妆台上铺着的一小方布。
